abstract: A 41-year-old asymptomatic male with no significant medical history had a heterogenous cystic tumor with a diameter of 5.1 cm containing fatty density in the anterior mediastinum and a nearby homogeneous enhancing nodule with a diameter of 2.0 cm were observed on chest computed tomography( CT). A malignant teratoma with mediastinal lymph node metastasis was suspected preoperatively. The tumor was completely removed via median sternotomy, with concomitant resection of the lung, pericardium, and right phrenic nerve. Postoperative pathological examination revealed a large mature cystic teratoma, 6.0 cm in diameter, and a small nodule, 3.7 cm in diameter, diagnosed as stageⅠ, type B2 thymoma. The postoperative course was uneventful, with no recurrence 30 months later. The simultaneous occurrence of mature teratoma and stageⅠthymoma is extremely rare. When suspecting a teratoma with small satellite nodules preoperatively, consideration of concurrent small thymoma is suggested.
abstract_ja: 特に重大な既往歴がない41歳の無症状男性が、胸部CT上、前縦隔に脂肪密度を含む直径5.1 cmの不均一嚢胞性腫瘍と、近くに直径2.0 cm の均一に造影される小結節を認めた。術前に悪性奇形腫による縦隔リンパ節転移が疑われた。腫瘍は正中胸骨切開で完全に摘出し、同時に肺、心膜、および右横隔神経を切除した。術後病理検査により、直径6.0 cm の大きな成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と、直径3.7 cm の小結節を認め、ステージI、type B2 胸腺腫と診断された。術後経過は良好で、30ヶ月後に再発を認めなかった。成熟奇形腫とステージI胸腺腫の同時発症は極めて稀である。術前に小さな衛星結節を伴う奇形腫が疑われる場合、並存する小さな胸腺腫を考慮することが提唱される。
